title: The Tooth
pages: The relic is heavier than it looks. It feels almost warm in your hand.
You see the storyteller again, younger, kneeling at this same altar. There is no dragon. There is a slime - a large, sad slime - and a knife.
He is crying. He is also grinning, because he knows what story he will tell about today.
'Five days, five nights,' he practices, under his breath. 'Five days, five nights.'
The vision fades. The relic in your hand is just a chipped piece of ivory. Could be from anything.
